name: Immich
description: High-performance photo and video backup with iPhone and Android apps, face recognition, smart search and shared albums.
author: Immich Team

volumes.name: library
volumes.description: Photo and video library (Immich's upload location). Choose a drive with room for the whole camera roll.

volumes.name: postgres
volumes.description: Immich database. Keep it on a local disk: network shares (SMB/NFS) are not supported.

volumes.name: model-cache
volumes.description: Machine-learning model cache (safe to delete; re-downloaded on demand).

env.label: Database password (generated by Talome for each install)

installNotes: Talome generates the internal database password (DB_PASSWORD) for each install; do not pass one. A reinstall reuses the password kept in the app's data folder so the existing database still opens. Map the library volume to the drive that should hold the photos; the database stays in Talome's app data on a local disk. The first account created at http://<server>:2283 becomes the admin.
